name: @sos-2/autonomy-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Continuous Autonomy Acceptance Suites (Work Order P12): the pinned proof that killing a body does not lose the task (lease LOST -> replacement inherits identity + checkpoint), that a task resumed from a verified checkpoint produces completion evidence identical to uninterrupted execution, that expired/revoked authority stops execution (fail closed, typed denial), that provider outages become truthful uncertainty/unavailability (SUSPECTED vs LOST; no fabricated liveness; bounded backoff then ASK), that body replacement preserves task/artifact identity with in-flight side effects reconciled, that cancellation survives body replacement, that cost accounting appends typed episodes per episode and the timeline replays exactly as the observation log, and the structural pins: zero new external dependencies (lockfile unchanged against base), offline determinism (no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers in owned package sources outside the documented apps/task-runner composition boundary), fixed vitest seed, only merged + P12-owned workspace imports (unmerged siblings never referenced).
